summary: 6 film announcements, 7 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Stag Dance
film.announcement: Run-A-Muck is developing Torrey Peters' novella 'Stag Dance' (part of 2026 Pulitzer Prize Finalist Collection) into a film.

film.title: Touch Grass
film.talent: Dave Clark (Director), Brad Miska, Chris White (Producers)
film.announcement: Promise AI is developing the horror feature 'Touch Grass' with Dave Clark directing and Brad Miska and 'Backrooms' EP Chris White producing.

film.title: Nice Eggs
film.talent: Jane Krakowski, Angourie Rice (Stars), Amanda Lipitz (Director)
film.announcement: Jane Krakowski and Angourie Rice star in coming-of-age drama 'Nice Eggs' from director Amanda Lipitz.

film.title: Ink
film.announcement: Netflix sets U.S. release date for Danny Boyle's tabloid drama 'Ink' starring Guy Pearce as Rupert Murdoch.

film.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
film.announcement: Samuel Goldwyn Films acquires North America rights to WestEnd Films' holiday comedy 'Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint'.

film.title: Paper Tiger
film.talent: Adam Driver, Miles Teller, Scarlett Johansson (Stars), James Gray (Director)
film.announcement: First trailer released for James Gray's NYC drama 'Paper Tiger' starring Adam Driver and Miles Teller as brothers.

tv.title: Ascension
tv.announcement: Apple TV+ orders Alfonso Cuarón cult horror thriller series 'Ascension' starring 'Outlander' alum Caitríona Balfe.

tv.title: Dig
tv.talent: Amy Poehler, Hugh Laurie (Stars), Mike Schur, J.J. Philbin (Creators)
tv.announcement: Peacock sets premiere date for comedy series 'Dig' starring Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie from Mike Schur and J.J. Philbin.

tv.title: Clueless
tv.announcement: 'Clueless' sequel series receives California TV tax credit allocation as part of Paramount's latest slate.

tv.title: Ascent
tv.announcement: Viola Davis' 'Ascent' receives California TV tax credit allocation.

tv.title: The Sticks
tv.talent: Scott Bakula, Logan Marshall-Green, Michelle Monaghan (Cast)
tv.announcement: Netflix YA hockey drama 'The Sticks' confirms cast including Scott Bakula, Logan Marshall-Green, and Michelle Monaghan.

tv.title: Scam 2010
tv.announcement: Sony LIV confirms 'Scam 2010' production will proceed despite legal threats.

tv.title: Typecast
tv.announcement: LA creator Sachin Kumar launches Prema Creative Co. with vertical comedy series 'Typecast' about Indian-American actor in Hollywood.
